text: Given the inherent differences in the protein quality measured, the methods can result in large discrepancies in the reported quality of protein-containing foods. Determining which single method is the best is difficult, but a case can be made that the PDCAAS and BV methods are the most relevant to human growth because they take protein digestibility into account. That said, because each method has drawbacks, the best approach to assessing protein quality is to take multiple measures-particularly PDCAAS and BV-into account.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
